concepts.definition: The date by which the charity's Annual Information Statement for the reporting year is due to be lodged with the ACNC, as published in the AIS dataset. This is a regulatory lodgement deadline, not a licence or registration date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers ACNC AIS lodgement deadlines; ext.licence.start_date/end_date are licence validity dates owned by the licence role, and entity.date_registered is a business registration date, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

concepts.definition: The date on which the ACNC received the charity's Annual Information Statement for the reporting year, as published in the AIS dataset. This is a lodgement receipt date, not the charity's establishment or registration date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records AIS lodgement receipt; entity.date_registered and ext.entity.date_established are business dates with different meaning, and ext.licence dates belong to the licence role.

concepts.definition: The ACNC charity size classification (Small, Medium or Large) reported for the charity in its Annual Information Statement. This is a regulator reporting classification, not a measure of company scale, revenue band or legal form.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.revenue_band is a revenue/turnover band from a named scheme owned by business; the ACNC size classification is a charity-role reporting category with its own thresholds and labels, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

concepts.definition: The start date of the reporting period covered by the charity's financial report as lodged with the ACNC. Defines the period scope for the charity's financial figures; it is not a registration or licence start date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept captures a charity financial-reporting period boundary; ext.licence.start_date is a licence commencement owned by the licence role and entity.date_registered is a business registration date.

concepts.definition: The end date of the reporting period covered by the charity's financial report as lodged with the ACNC. Defines the period scope for the charity's financial figures; it is not a financial year-end attribute or a licence end date.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.financial_year_end is a recurring dd-Mon reporting-cycle attribute owned by business, not a specific period end date for a charity's lodged financial report; ext.licence.end_date belongs to the licence role.

concepts.definition: The date on which the ACNC received the charity's financial report for the reporting period. A document lodgement receipt date, distinct from the AIS receipt date and from the report's period dates.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers financial-report lodgement receipt; dyn.charity.ais_received_date in this patch refers to the AIS lodgement, a different document, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The type of financial statement the charity lodged with the ACNC, e.g. special purpose or general purpose financial statements (including simplified disclosure variants). A reporting-framework classification, not a legal form or entity type.
values: General purpose financial statements - simplified disclosure
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept describes the accounting framework of a lodged financial statement; entity.entity_type and ext.entity.legal_form describe legal structure, not reporting basis.

concepts.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity's financial report for the reporting period carries a modification (y/n). A report-quality indicator, not a registration or compliance status.
concepts.why_not_existing: dyn.charity.registration_status is a regulator registration state; no shortlisted concept records whether a lodged financial report was modified.

concepts.definition: The type of modification the auditor or reviewer applied to the charity's financial report, as published by the ACNC (e.g. qualified/qualification, disclaimed/disclaimer). Only meaningful where the report modification flag is y.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept captures audit/review modification types; dyn.charity.report_modification_flag in this patch only records presence, not the modification kind.

concepts.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity's financial report is consolidated with more than one entity (y/n). A reporting-scope indicator, not evidence of group structure or ownership.
source_paths: report consolidated with more than one entity
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records whether a charity's financial report is consolidated; entity types and relationships are out of scope here and this is a reporting attribute of the charity role.

concepts.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity submitted its financial report to a cooperative/state regulator instead of the ACNC (y/n). A lodgement-channel indicator, not a registration status.
source_paths: coop financial report submitted to regulator
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers alternative financial-report lodgement channels; dyn.charity.registration_status is a registration state, not a lodgement route.

concepts.definition: The accounting basis (Cash or Accrual) on which the charity prepared its reported financial information for the reporting period, as published by the ACNC. A reporting-basis classification, not a financial measure.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept describes the accounting basis of reported financials; dyn.charity.financial_statement_type in this patch covers the statement framework, a different attribute.

reuse.dyn.charity.registration_status: Reused unchanged: ACNC charity registration status owned by the charity role, matching this group's charity scope; not used for any column in this group but retained as an accepted prior concept.
reuse.dyn.charity.basic_religious_charity: Reused unchanged: ACNC basic religious charity flag owned by the charity role; not a column in this group but an accepted prior concept.
